description: The Project Management Services that are being procured under this competition are for the organising, overseeing and management, procurement and delivery of SEN refurbishing within existing school buildings and/or the provision of modular accommodation for SEN and/or mainstream classroom and ancillary space with associated site works. The services will include both the management and the delivery of the services. The successful Project Management Firm shall receive a brief from the Department of Education and Youth to refurbish existing spaces within a school for a new purpose or to deliver a new accommodation on the grounds of an existing school or a combination of both. As a design build contract the PM’s Multidisciplinary Design Team will become Technical Designers as they develop the preliminary brief design that the contractors will take to complete the detailed design and construct.

title: Intent to Sole Source - Medical/Scientific Instruments for the Department of Transfusion Medicine, NIH Clinical Center
description: This is a Notice of Intent, not a request for proposal. The National Institute of Health, Clinical Center (NIH-CC) intends to negotiate on an other than full and open competition basis with the following vendor: Fisher Scientific. Acquisition Description: The NIH Clinical Center, Department of Transfusion Medicine (DTM), Infectious Diseases Section requires acquisition of a 1) Real-Time PCR System, 2) an Automated Nucleic Acid Extractor and 3) a microvolume spectrophotometer to support clinical research and the development, optimization, and validation of diagnostic assays for hepatitis viruses and other transfusion-transmitted pathogens. The required system must support generation of high-quality quantification data from clinical specimens, including viral RNA/DNA and host-derived nucleic acids. The instrument must enable applications such as targeted genome amplification, work with a wider dynamic detection range, support the library prep for viral genome sequencing, and assay development workflows necessary for evaluating test performance and refining diagnostic methods prior to implementation in a clinical testing environment. The system must meet the following functional and operational requirements: High data accuracy and reproducibility to ensure reliable detection of viral variants and evaluation of assay performance; Low- to moderate-throughput capability appropriate for assay development, pilot studies, and validation activities involving smaller sample sets; Rapid turnaround times to support iterative testing and optimization of clinical assays; Flexible run configurations that allow efficient processing of varying sample volumes without excess capacity; Cost-efficient operation, including the ability to minimize per-run and per-sample costs for pathogen detection; Integrated and streamlined workflows, including nucleic acid extraction, amplification, quantification and data analysis within a platform from the same vendor to reduce complexity and variability; Ease of use and standardized operation, supporting reproducibility and implementation in a clinical laboratory environment; Compatibility with established nucleic acid preparation and amplification methods and existing laboratory workflows. The flexibility to be using the systems in a CLIA certified environment. The statutory authority for this sole source requirement is 41 U.S.C. 253(c) (1) as implemented by FAR 6.302-1 only one responsible source and no other supply of service will satisfy agency requirements. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. All responsible sources that could provide the required may submit a capability statement that will be considered by email (subject line to reference NOI-OLAO-CC-27-000121) by 12:00 PM eastern standard time on 10/23/2026 to: valerie.gregorio@nih.gov. All responses received by the closing date of this synopsis will be considered by the Government. A determination not to compete this requirement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government.

Under the authority of FAR 6.302-1, only one responsible source and no other will satisfy agency requirements, the Government intends to award a Firm-Fixed price Sole Source contract to Analytical Products Institute as only one source reasonably available. The Contractor shall be a CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) approved Proficiency Provider as required to maintain TJC accreditation and CLIA licensure. Upon completion of testing and submittal of PT unknown samples, the PT results are provided to the Laboratory in a final report. This report indicated acceptable or unacceptable testing performance. The Laboratory's long-term testing performance must be monitored to ensure consecutive reported Proficiency testing events of the same unknown PT material does not occur. Should consecutive reported testing events occur, the Laboratory shall take remedial action and cease patient testing until satisfactory performance can be proven. Analytical Products Institute is the only vendor that possesses the capability to provide PT material for all test systems on the Red Lake Service Unit test menus. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 621511, Medical Laboratories with a size standard of 41.5M. Prieš pradedant rengti projektą privalu atlikti archeologinius ar kitus privalomuosius tyrimus, nuo kurių priklausys projekto apimtis ir projekto etapų kiekis. Vėliau privalomai gauti specialiuosius reikalavimus ir prisijungimo sąlygas, atlikti kitus tyrimus ir t.t. Surinkti būtinus duomenis, reikalingus Statinio projektui. Veikiant Užsakovo vardu paslaugų tekėjas gauna statybą leidžiantį dokumentą ir visus kitus suderinimus, patvirtinimus ir leidimus, reikalingus techninio darbo projekto tinkamam parengimui ir vėlesniam Statinio statybos vykdymui, pagal parengtą techninį darbo projektą bei atlikti projekto vykdymo priežiūrą. title: Finland – Cesspool or septic tank emptying services – Lietteiden keräys ja kuljetus saaristoalueella
description: Tämä hankinta sisältää pääsääntöisesti meriteitse huoltoaluksella suoritettavia lietetyhjennyksiä. Urakoitsijalla tulee olla koko sopimuskauden ajan käytettävissään tehtävän edellyttämä huoltoalus sekä muu tarvittava kuljetuskalusto meriteitse saavutettavien kohteiden hoitamiseksi. Urakoitsija sopii tyhjennyksiin liittyvistä yksityiskohdista suoraan asiakkaiden kanssa. Ennakkoon suunniteltujen ja reititettyjen tyhjennysten lisäksi urakoitsija vastaanottaa asiakkailta uusia tyhjennystilauksia, sopii niiden toteuttamisesta ja vastaa niiden reitityksestä. Urakoitsija vastaanottaa ja toteuttaa myös pikatyhjennystilauksia. Urakka-alue sijoittuu Lounais-Suomen Jätehuollon saaristoalueelle, pois lukien Uudenkaupungin saaristoalue. Hankintailmoituksessa on yksi (1) osa: Urakka-alue A (Kaarinan, Maskun, Naantalin, Paraisten, Sauvon ja Turun alueella) Tarjouspyyntö ei sisällä lieteajoneuvolla saavutettavia tyhjennyksiä mantereella tai saarilla, joihin on maantie-, silta- tai lossiyhteys. Kyseisillä alueilla voi kuitenkin olla lieteajoneuvolla saavuttamattomissa olevia kohteita, jotka vaativat tyhjennyksen meriteitse ja kuuluvat siten näihin saaristoalueen urakoihin. Katso karttaliitteestä (Liite 3): LSJH:n muut urakka-alueet. Soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät tarjoukset otetaan vertailuun. Valintaperusteena on kokonaistaloudellinen edullisuus ja valinta tehdään vaatimukset täyttävistä tarjouksista alimman hinnan mukaan. Valinta voidaan tehdä alimman hinnan mukaan, sillä hankintailmoituksessa ja siihen liittyvässä sopimuksessa on määritelty palvelulle korkea laatutaso. Yksikköurakkahintaan kuuluu kuljetuskaluston ajaminen keräyskohteeseen alusta tai yhteysalusta hyödyntäen, keräysjärjestelmän lietteen tyhjentäminen alukseen tai kuljetuskalustoon, lietteen kuljettaminen aluksesta tai kuljetuskalustosta johonkin määritetyistä vastaanottopaikoista ja kuorman purkaminen sekä tilaajan ohjeiden mukaisten merkintöjen kirjaaminen ja valokuvien tallentaminen ajoneuvopäätteelle.
